description: List messages from a channel or thread, newest first. Provide before, after, or around snowflake IDs to paginate or center the search window. To fetch a specific message by ID use discord_get_message, and to search messages by text or author across an entire server use discord_search_guild_messages. Page older messages with before=next_before. Bot permissions it may need: View Channel, Read Message History. Read-only; safe to retry.

after.description: Get messages posted after this message snowflake ID (use next_after to page forward in time). Use only one of before, after or around

around.description: Get messages centered around this message snowflake ID. Use only one of before, after or around

before.description: Get messages posted before this message snowflake ID (use next_before to page backward in time). Use only one of before, after or around

channel_id.description: ID of the channel or thread to list messages from

limit.description: Max number of messages to return (1-100; default is 50)
